research_note: Broad Nov 5 research across employer sites, Egyptian boards, global remote boards and Europe/UK. Direct source checked where available. Closed/unverified LinkedIn and ATS posts excluded from active results. Some older listings retained only as needs_verification follow-ups; no vacancy-specific European visa sponsorship confirmed.

jobs.title: Unreal Engine Developer
jobs.experience: 0–1 year listed; no graduation-year rule stated
jobs.summary: Build interactive architectural and VR scenes with Unreal Engine, Blueprints, lighting, materials and optimisation.
jobs.why_fit: Omar's UE5, Blueprint, Maya, Blender and SketchUp work aligns closely. A realistic non-gaming entry into professional Unreal projects.
jobs.caveats: The original LinkedIn vacancy (9 months old) explicitly says it is no longer accepting applications. A third-party STJ listing remains visible without confirmation of an active opening. Enquire directly at ArtCreator before applying; treat this as a speculative follow-up, not a currently confirmed vacancy.

jobs.title: Junior Gameplay Programmer (Unreal Engine)
jobs.experience: 0–3 years; academic and indie projects accepted
jobs.egypt_eligibility: Only if he can relocate to NYC; work-authorisation support unconfirmed
jobs.visa_status: Sponsorship and relocation support not stated
jobs.summary: Junior role building core mechanics and shooter systems with UE C++ and Blueprints alongside senior engineers.
jobs.why_fit: Echoes of Annihilation is a close portfolio match: third-person shooter, enemy AI, perception and navigation. Employer explicitly counts indie/academic projects.
jobs.caveats: New York hybrid requirement is firm. No confirmation of US visa sponsorship; do not treat as feasible without asking the employer first.

jobs.title: Unreal Engine Developer (Mid-Level)
jobs.experience: 1–3 years of Unreal Engine development; does not say commercial-only
jobs.egypt_eligibility: Yes — employer expressly lists Egypt, remote and worldwide
jobs.visa_status: Not required for remote work from Egypt; contractor/payroll terms to confirm
jobs.summary: UE5 developer across games, VR, interactive simulations, training and architectural visualisation; site has an active application form.
jobs.why_fit: Direct overlap with all three of Omar's UE projects, C++, Blueprints, VR, simulation and independent feature ownership.
jobs.caveats: Role is called mid-level and expects 1–3 years; Omar must demonstrate equivalent hands-on depth through polished independent demos. Verify employer credentials and contractual arrangements before sharing sensitive documents.

jobs.employer: Unreal Source (Discord job post; employer unverified)
jobs.title: UnrealE Gameplay Programmer (6-month UE5 contract)
jobs.work_mode: Remote — any time zone with some overlap
jobs.experience: Playable demo or shipped game; multiplayer replication experience required
jobs.egypt_eligibility: Remote from any time zone with team overlap; Egypt appears compatible, confirm contract eligibility
jobs.visa_status: Not applicable if contracted from Egypt; verify employer entity
jobs.summary: Implement combat, champion abilities, game modes and multiplayer features for a UE5 MMO; posting says applications close 4 December 2026.
jobs.why_fit: Omar can show UE5/C++/Blueprints and gameplay AI; independent playable demos count, but multiplayer replication is a material gap.
jobs.caveats: Imported from a Discord freelance channel. Studio identity and payment terms were not independently verified. Investigate recruiter before providing sensitive information or accepting any trial; no job guarantee.

jobs.title: Junior Unreal Engine Developer — XR
jobs.work_mode: Hybrid in Benevento or fully remote (country restrictions unstated)
jobs.experience: At least 2 years developing with Unreal Engine C++; diploma/degree in CS preferred
jobs.egypt_eligibility: Unknown — full-remote policy may apply to Italy only; ask about Egypt contractors
jobs.visa_status: No vacancy-specific visa sponsorship or relocation confirmed
jobs.summary: Non-gaming XR Unreal/C++ engineering with VR and interactive 3D systems. Live employer form on company careers site.
jobs.why_fit: Omar's VR Unreal projects, computer-science degree and C++ gameplay systems are relevant, with simulations offering a credible entry path.
jobs.caveats: Two years UE C++ experience required; no evidence that remote means Egypt eligible. The salary band alone does not establish a viable immigration route.

jobs.title: Technical Artist / Unreal Generalist
jobs.work_mode: In-house or remote freelance; cross-border eligibility not specified
jobs.experience: Strong Unreal + Blender/Maya, Niagara, materials and mobile MR; no specific minimum years listed
jobs.egypt_eligibility: Unknown — studio offers remote but has not confirmed Egypt contracting
jobs.visa_status: Not stated; freelance may avoid UK relocation if Egypt accepted
jobs.summary: Build interactive mixed-reality experiences, Unreal scenes and systems, materials and Niagara effects alongside engineers and artists.
jobs.why_fit: UE5, MetaHuman, Blender/Maya and Project Zero Requiem animation/cinematics offer partial technical-art fit.
jobs.caveats: Needs convincing materials/Niagara/MR demo, stronger tech-art reel than Omar's current gameplay-focused portfolio. Studio's separate Junior–Mid Unreal Developer role explicitly requires UK-based applicants and is excluded.

jobs.title: Technical Animator / Animation Engineer (Unreal)
jobs.experience: Experienced technical animator; strong animation blueprints, state machines and montages
jobs.salary: Not disclosed — applicants quote their own rate
jobs.egypt_eligibility: Unknown — remote location not geographically defined
jobs.visa_status: Not stated; contracted remotely if employer permits Egypt
jobs.summary: Remote contract focused on player/boss animation, UE gameplay animation systems and optimisation. Live application form asks for reel and rate.
jobs.why_fit: Project Zero Requiem's motion-capture/animation systems and cinematic pipelines are relevant.
jobs.caveats: Employer asks for an experienced technical animator. Omar needs an unusually convincing state-machine, montage and animation-blueprint breakdown to compete.

jobs.title: Unity Developer (Junior / Mid-Level)
jobs.experience: Advertised junior/mid-level; personal Unity projects welcomed
jobs.summary: Create interactive Unity applications for mobile and PC with C#, UI, API integration and optimisation; a legitimate alternative first developer role.
jobs.why_fit: Omar has Unity, C#, Python/JS and Git skills; this could provide first commercial development experience before moving to Unreal.
jobs.caveats: Wuzzuf page says posted about five months ago and does not show an active Apply button; vacancy current availability is unverified. It is a Unity fallback, not an Unreal role.

jobs.title: Senior Unity Game Developer
jobs.work_mode: Fully remote; flexible location (Riyadh GMT+3 core hours)
jobs.experience: 3–5 years; senior developer / full-stack gameplay ownership
jobs.egypt_eligibility: Flexible location in job text and Egypt listing; confirm Egyptian contract and payments
jobs.visa_status: Not applicable if remote contracted from Egypt
jobs.summary: Own gameplay programming and interactive/mobile app development for a small remote team; listing states a 29 November 2026 deadline.
jobs.why_fit: Unity, C#, Blueprint familiarity, Blender and systems experience overlap, but the vacancy is a less relevant Unity backup.
jobs.caveats: Likely too senior for Omar's first paid development job. Third-party repost not confirmed from current employer careers source; avoid prioritising.
